metadata.tesseract:about: Tesseract Renderer — Master DAG The single file that is the project. Edit me to reshape the system. Agents read this file to know their next move. Subsystems toggle on/off by editing my child `<g>` elements. See RUN20_TESSERACT_RENDERER_SPEC.md for the full architecture contract.

g.text: project orchestrator · agent traversal map · subsystem registry · render scheduler
edit any cell to reshape the system · agents read this file to know their next move
Layer 0 — how to use this file
1. Parse all <g> with gently:pass attribute. 2. Filter to nodes where every upstream has <visit result="ok"/>.
3. Pick one eligible. 4. Do its work. 5. Append <visit agent="..." at="..." result="..." crystal="..."/> inside the <g>.
Toggle subsystems by editing gently:status. Disable passes via gently:enabled="false". Override per-project via gently:extends.

covers spatial probes, multi_modal, painter, capsule, lighting, scene_circle, god_box
